spreadsheetId.description: The ID of the spreadsheet (the Drive file id). Resolve from a name with find_spreadsheets.

sheet_id.label: Worksheet ID
sheet_id.description: The numeric worksheet (tab) id (gid). Resolve via sheets_get_spreadsheet or find-worksheet. The first tab is usually 0.

sheets_append_values.label: Append Values (Raw)
sheets_append_values.description: Append rows of values after the last row with data in a worksheet.

spreadsheet_id.label: Spreadsheet ID
spreadsheet_id.description: The ID of the spreadsheet (the Drive file id). Resolve from a name with find_spreadsheets.

worksheet_title.label: Worksheet Title
worksheet_title.description: The exact tab title to append to. Must match the tab name exactly (including spacing/case). Resolve via sheets_get_spreadsheet or find-worksheet.

range.label: Range (A1 Notation)
range.description: The A1 range that locates the table to append after, e.g. A1 or A:D. The API finds the last row with data inside this range and appends below it; it does not overwrite the range itself.

values.label: Values
values.description: A 2D array of rows to append, e.g. [["Alice",30],["Bob",25]]. Each inner array is one new row.

value_input_option.label: Value Input Option
value_input_option.description: USER_ENTERED parses values like the Sheets UI (formulas, dates, numbers). RAW stores them verbatim as strings.

sheets_append_values.afterResponse: return {updatedRange: response.updates?.updatedRange, updatedRows: response.updates?.updatedRows, updatedColumns: response.updates?.updatedColumns, updatedCells: response.updates?.updatedCells};

sheets_auto_resize_dimensions.label: Auto-Resize Columns/Rows
sheets_auto_resize_dimensions.description: Auto-fit the width of columns or height of rows to their content.

spreadsheetId.label: Spreadsheet ID
spreadsheetId.description: The ID of the spreadsheet (the Drive file id). Resolve from a name with find_spreadsheets.

sheet_id.label: Worksheet ID
sheet_id.description: The numeric worksheet (tab) id (gid). Resolve via sheets_get_spreadsheet or find-worksheet. The first tab is usually 0.

dimension.label: Dimension
dimension.description: Whether to auto-resize columns (width) or rows (height).

start_index.label: Start Index (0-based)
start_index.description: The first column/row to resize, 0-based and inclusive. Column A / row 1 is index 0. The range is half-open: [start, end).

end_index.label: End Index (0-based, exclusive)
end_index.description: The index just past the last column/row to resize (exclusive). To resize only column A use start 0, end 1; to resize A–C use start 0, end 3.

sheets_delete_dimension.label: Delete Rows/Columns
sheets_delete_dimension.description: Delete a range of rows or columns, shifting the rest.

spreadsheetId.label: Spreadsheet ID
spreadsheetId.description: The ID of the spreadsheet (the Drive file id). Resolve from a name with find_spreadsheets.

sheet_id.label: Worksheet ID
sheet_id.description: The numeric worksheet (tab) id (gid). Resolve via sheets_get_spreadsheet or find-worksheet. The first tab is usually 0.

dimension.label: Dimension
dimension.description: Whether to delete rows or columns.

start_index.label: Start Index (0-based)
start_index.description: The first row/column to delete, 0-based and inclusive. Row 1 / column A is index 0, so deleting "row 5" means start 4. The range is half-open: [start, end).

end_index.label: End Index (0-based, exclusive)
end_index.description: The index just past the last deleted row/column (exclusive). To delete only row 5 use start 4, end 5; to delete rows 5–7 use start 4, end 7.

sheets_format_cells.label: Format Cells
sheets_format_cells.description: Apply formatting to a range of rows in a worksheet.

spreadsheetId.label: Spreadsheet ID
spreadsheetId.description: The ID of the spreadsheet (the Drive file id). Resolve from a name with find_spreadsheets.

sheet_id.description: The numeric worksheet (tab) id. Resolve via sheets_get_spreadsheet or find-worksheet. The first tab is usually 0.

starting_row.label: Starting row
starting_row.description: The first row number where formatting should begin (1-based).

ending_row.label: Ending row
ending_row.description: The last row number where formatting should stop (leave empty to format only the starting row).

sheets_get_spreadsheet.label: Get Spreadsheet Info
sheets_get_spreadsheet.description: Fetch a spreadsheet's title and the list of its worksheets (tabs).

spreadsheet_id.label: Spreadsheet ID
spreadsheet_id.description: The ID of the spreadsheet (the Drive file id). Resolve from a name with find_spreadsheets.

include_grid_data.label: Include Grid Data
include_grid_data.description: When true, also returns the cell data for every worksheet. Leave off (default) for a lightweight metadata-only response.

sheets_insert_dimension.label: Insert Rows/Columns
sheets_insert_dimension.description: Insert blank rows or columns at a position, shifting existing data.

spreadsheetId.label: Spreadsheet ID
spreadsheetId.description: The ID of the spreadsheet (the Drive file id). Resolve from a name with find_spreadsheets.

sheet_id.label: Worksheet ID
sheet_id.description: The numeric worksheet (tab) id (gid). Resolve via sheets_get_spreadsheet or find-worksheet. The first tab is usually 0.

dimension.label: Dimension
dimension.description: Whether to insert rows or columns.

start_index.label: Start Index (0-based)
start_index.description: Where to start inserting, 0-based and inclusive. Index 0 = before the first row/column (row 1 / column A). The range is half-open: [start, end).

end_index.label: End Index (0-based, exclusive)
end_index.description: The index just past the last inserted row/column (exclusive). The number inserted is (end - start): to insert 1 use start N, end N+1; to insert 3 at the top use start 0, end 3.

inherit_from_before.label: Inherit Formatting From Before
inherit_from_before.description: When true, new rows/columns inherit formatting from the row/column before them; when false (default), from the one after.

sheets_update_dimension_properties.label: Resize / Hide Rows or Columns
sheets_update_dimension_properties.description: Set a fixed pixel size for rows/columns, or hide/unhide them.

spreadsheetId.label: Spreadsheet ID
spreadsheetId.description: The ID of the spreadsheet (the Drive file id). Resolve from a name with find_spreadsheets.

sheet_id.label: Worksheet ID
sheet_id.description: The numeric worksheet (tab) id (gid). Resolve via sheets_get_spreadsheet or find-worksheet. The first tab is usually 0.

dimension.label: Dimension
dimension.description: Whether to act on columns (width) or rows (height).

start_index.label: Start Index (0-based)
start_index.description: The first column/row to update, 0-based and inclusive. Column A / row 1 is index 0. The range is half-open: [start, end).

end_index.label: End Index (0-based, exclusive)
end_index.description: The index just past the last column/row to update (exclusive). To update only column A use start 0, end 1.

pixel_size.label: Pixel Size
pixel_size.description: The fixed width (for columns) or height (for rows) in pixels. Leave empty to only change the hidden state.

hidden.label: Hidden
hidden.description: Whether the rows/columns are hidden. Leave empty or pick Leave unchanged to keep the current setting.

sheets_update_sheet_properties.label: Update Worksheet Properties
sheets_update_sheet_properties.description: Update a worksheet's frozen rows/columns, tab color, or hidden state.

spreadsheetId.label: Spreadsheet ID
spreadsheetId.description: The ID of the spreadsheet (the Drive file id). Resolve from a name with find_spreadsheets.

sheet_id.label: Worksheet ID
sheet_id.description: The numeric worksheet (tab) id (gid). Resolve via sheets_get_spreadsheet or find-worksheet. The first tab is usually 0.

frozen_row_count.label: Frozen Row Count
frozen_row_count.description: Number of rows to freeze at the top (e.g. 1 to freeze a header row). Set 0 to unfreeze.

frozen_column_count.label: Frozen Column Count
frozen_column_count.description: Number of columns to freeze at the left. Set 0 to unfreeze.

tab_color.label: Tab Color
tab_color.description: HEX color code for the tab, e.g. #FF0000.

hidden.label: Hidden
hidden.description: Whether the worksheet tab is hidden. Leave empty or pick Leave unchanged to keep the current setting.

sheets_update_values.label: Write Cell Range
sheets_update_values.description: Write a 2D array of values into a worksheet at a specific A1 range.

spreadsheet_id.label: Spreadsheet ID
spreadsheet_id.description: The ID of the spreadsheet (the Drive file id). Resolve from a name with find_spreadsheets.

worksheet_title.label: Worksheet Title
worksheet_title.description: The exact tab title to write to. Must match the tab name exactly (including spacing/case). Resolve via sheets_get_spreadsheet or find-worksheet.

range.label: Range (A1 Notation)
range.description: The cell range to write to, e.g. A1:D10. The shape of the values array must match this range (a 1x1 range cannot accept a 2x2 array).

values.label: Values
values.description: A 2D array of values, e.g. [["Name","Age"],["Alice",30]]. Each inner array is one row (when major dimension is ROWS) or one column (when COLUMNS).

value_input_option.label: Value Input Option
value_input_option.description: USER_ENTERED parses values like the Sheets UI (formulas, dates, numbers). RAW stores them verbatim as strings.

major_dimension.label: Major Dimension
major_dimension.description: Whether each inner array of Values is a row (ROWS, default) or a column (COLUMNS).

sheets_update_values.afterResponse: return {updatedRange: response?.updatedRange, updatedRows: response?.updatedRows, updatedColumns: response?.updatedColumns, updatedCells: response?.updatedCells};
